issue_title: Fix for gen-delims escaping behaviour in path/query/fragment
issue_body: Path gen-delimiters should preserve square brackets instead of percent-encoding them.
problem_statement: HTTPX percent-encodes square brackets in URL paths.
expected_behavior: Square brackets remain raw in path bytes.
reproduction_command: PYTHONPATH=tmp/httpx2701-before-src python -c import httpx; assert httpx.URL('http://example.com/a[b]').raw_path == b'/a[b]'
environment: Windows AMD64; Python 3.11.15; fixed source tarballs
acceptance_test: hidden test checks square brackets remain in URL path
